blocks.text: TradeflowBD's Thrift vertical handles second-hand garment retail — inbound consignment shipments, unique SKU barcodes, garment measurements, landed costing, POS sales, and returns. The web admin (`/:slug/app/thrift/*`) covers the full lifecycle, but warehouse floor work exposed critical gaps:
Pain points on the warehouse floor

Finding an item's status requires logging into the web admin
Human error in counting; no real-time discrepancy detection
Items scanned at wrong shelf/box sit undetected until a sale fails
Bangladeshi warehouse staff need Bengali labels for daily workflows
In noisy warehouses, operators can't tell if a scan succeeded without checking the screen

blocks.text: How do you let warehouse staff register garments, scan barcodes, audit shelves, and fix misplaced stock — all from a phone at the shelf — while keeping the TradeflowBD web admin in sync?

**Thrift App** is a Capacitor Android companion (also runs as a responsive web SPA) that connects to the same Supabase backend as TradeflowBD's Thrift vertical. It handles the warehouse-floor workflows the web admin was never designed for.

blocks.text: Decision 1 — Google ML Kit over web-based decoders

rows: JavaScript barcode libraries struggle with Code-128 thermal labels in low light, at angles, and on curved garment hang-tags.
Use `@capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning` which wraps Google's on-device ML Kit scanner with auto-zoom, native UI, and a camera overlay fallback.
Hardware-accelerated decoding on Android with graceful degradation when the native scan UI is unavailable.

blocks.text: Decision 2 — Continuous scan queue for batch operations

rows: Registering or relocating 50+ items during shipment intake requires scanning each item, navigating a form, and saving — far too slow.
Continuous scan mode builds a queue of scanned items. Operators batch-apply shelf moves or status changes via `bulk_update_thrift_stock_locations` and `bulk_update_thrift_stock_statuses` RPCs.
Scan many, act once. Bulk operations complete in a single database round-trip.

blocks.text: Decision 3 — Audit mode with three-tier discrepancy detection

rows: Paper stocktakes can't detect items physically present but logged at the wrong shelf — the most common warehouse error.
Audit mode loads expected items for a shelf/box, then on each scan: match → verified, no match but exists elsewhere → misplaced (with one-tap relocate), not in DB → unknown.
Structured stocktake with real-time progress bar and actionable discrepancy summary.

blocks.text: Decision 4 — Atomic RPC registration, not client-side inserts

rows: Stock registration touches `thrift_stocks`, `thrift_barcodes`, and `thrift_stock_images` — partial client writes leave orphaned records.
Single `register_thrift_stock_from_app` RPC handles the full registration atomically. Image upload to Cloudinary happens first; the RPC receives the `secure_url`.
No partial registrations. Duplicate barcode/image detection before write.

blocks.text: Decision 5 — Bilingual UI for warehouse operators

rows: Warehouse staff in Bangladesh are more productive in Bengali, but the tech stack is English-first.
Full Vue I18n integration with English and Bengali (বাংলা), persisted locale preference, covering all operator-facing workflows including help dialogs.
Operators use the app in their preferred language without a separate build.
In noisy warehouses, operators can't hear notification sounds or see the screen while handling garments.
Web Audio API success/error tones + `navigator.vibrate()` haptic patterns triggered on every scan result via `triggerScanFeedback()`.
Instant tactile and audio confirmation — success feels different from error without looking at the device.
Web OAuth + native Google ID token

items.text: **Barcode scanning engine** — ML Kit integration with module auto-install, native UI + overlay fallback, barcode normalization, and audio/haptic feedback
**Stock registration workflow** — End-to-end mobile intake: barcode → photo → metadata → Cloudinary upload → atomic RPC
**Continuous scan + bulk queue** — Batch shelf moves and status updates via bulk RPCs
**Audit mode** — Full stocktake workflow with verified/missing/misplaced detection and bulk relocation
**Bilingual operator UI** — English and Bengali across all workflows with persisted locale
**Native Android auth** — Google Sign-In via ID token (no Custom Tab redirect on Android)
